dialogues.speaker: Yvette
dialogues.text: Mind you don't get hit! Tools aren't living people — they don't know where they're going.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you do?

dialogues.speaker: Yvette
dialogues.text: Oh, a youngster with manners. Looks like you aren't one of those blockheaded Spina newbies.

dialogues.speaker: Yvette
dialogues.text: I work with those clumsy idiots way too often to maintain a good temper... Of course, not that my temper was ever all that good.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: My thanks for the warning.

dialogues.speaker: Yvette
dialogues.text: No issue. You not getting hurt is good enough.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: May I ask who you are?

dialogues.speaker: Yvette
dialogues.text: Right, forgot to introduce myself. I'm the technical advisor to the Spina di Rosula. I might be old, but my hands and brain still work just fine.

dialogues.speaker: Yvette
dialogues.text: Now, don't let the headaches I get with greenhorns who keep breaking things fool you — I very much enjoy my work here at the Spina.

dialogues.speaker: Yvette
dialogues.text: Back when I was at the Fontaine Research Institute, I quit on my own — too hard working with people with my crappy temper.

dialogues.speaker: Yvette
dialogues.text: As it turned out, that was a smart decision. Otherwise, you might have had to find my bones at the bottom of the sea.

dialogues.speaker: Yvette
dialogues.text: Things are different here. Doesn't matter if you're eight or eighty. So long as you've the ability, there's a place for you to use it.

dialogues.speaker: Yvette
dialogues.text: Be careful, and mind your head! It's a mess right now, so don't say I didn't warn you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're...

dialogues.speaker: Yvette
dialogues.text: What? You think that just because I'm old I'm gonna stay in the shelter with the others and wait for everything to be fixed?

dialogues.speaker: Yvette
dialogues.text: Hmph, in your dreams! If I can still crack fish skulls with a hammer, then I still have the strength to work.

dialogues.speaker: Yvette
dialogues.text: Besides, now is when technical consultants are most needed. They'd best not think about sending me packing.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Yvette
dialogues.text: No issue. You not getting hurt is good enough.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How fortunate.

dialogues.speaker: Yvette
dialogues.text: Yes. Perhaps this is how fate is telling me "You're on the right path."

dialogues.speaker: Yvette
dialogues.text: But as a former scientist, I have to say this is all too abstract.

dialogues.speaker: Yvette
dialogues.text: In other words, the right path in an orderly society should be one where people with proper capabilities gain recognition.
